proposition: Neural guidance can reduce time to a specified quality target relative to native baseline B on some evaluated instances.
reference: S_B/G = 1 means equal elapsed time; S_B/G > 1 favours G.
evidence: Qualified paired target times and G-only/B-only attainment counts at 10%, 5%, 1% and 0.01%.
interpretation: Conditional within the 15 selected original parents and single prescribed seed/configuration; no universal-superiority requirement.

proposition: Neural guidance can add computational value relative to the independent relaxation-based comparator R.
reference: S_R/G = 1 means equal elapsed time; S_R/G > 1 favours G.
evidence: Qualified R/G target times, attainment, support and Start-processing evidence under the same MILP contract.
interpretation: R is generated independently of G; this comparison examines the complete guidance procedures and does not isolate a unique causal learning effect.

proposition: The relative ordering of B/R/G can vary with the gap target and with primal versus dual progress.
reference: Stable ordering across targets is a descriptive reference, not an assumed law.
evidence: Within-parent four-target trajectories, qualified incumbents, bounds, presolve/root work and search effort.
interpretation: Association-based explanation; targets are repeated views of the same run rather than independent solver replications.

proposition: A solver-time benefit can be offset by preparation, while reusable artifacts can make a conditional elapsed-time saving possible.
reference: C_G(k) = C_B(k) or C_R(k) is break-even; comparator/G cost factor > 1 favours G.
evidence: Nested timing ledger, reusable preparation, recurring per-use costs and explicit reuse assumptions.
interpretation: An accounting proposition under a stated scenario; theoretical break-even is not observed deployment evidence.

proposition: Four-GPU DDP can shorten training elapsed time relative to serial training when global work is held equivalent.
reference: T_serial/T_DDP = 1 means equal elapsed time; values > 1 favour DDP.
evidence: Matched 4200-update returns, parent-level validation/predictive measures, clocks, GPU-hours and memory.
interpretation: One controlled training pair; no new non-inferiority margin, repeated training campaign or causal quality-loss assertion.
